reason: The hypothesis directly restates the known contrast between Al/Si (protective) and Mn (non-protective) oxidation behavior in CrFeCoNi-based HEAs, as reported in P1, P8, and P35, without introducing a new material, regime, or mechanistic link. The proposed test is a straightforward comparison of these known outcomes.
copied_elements: Expose CrFeCoNiX alloys to >900 °C oxidative atmosphere
Mn forms non-protective, volatile, cracked oxides
Mn-containing alloys show thicker oxide, higher mass gain, spallation
Al-containing alloys show thin, coherent, protective oxide
Comparison of Al/Si vs. Mn effect on oxidation
Use of HTXRD, SEM/TEM, TGA for oxide characterization
